priorityList: Summon your pet or use Grimoire of Sacrifice if talented.
Cast Soul Fire as a pre-cast or whenever you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Malevolence, ideally while your Infernal is active.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial buffs during your Infernal or Malevolence windows.
Maintain the Wither damage-over-time effect; refresh it if it has less than 5 seconds remaining or before a Chaos Bolt lands if talented into Internal Combustion.
Cast Conflagrate if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards and no Backdraft stacks.
Cast Shadowburn if the target is below 20% health or if the Fiendish Cruelty buff is active, especially during Malevolence or Infernal.
Cast Chaos Bolt if you have 4 or more Soul Shards, or while Malevolence or Infernal is active.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have 3 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Incinerate if the Chaotic Inferno buff is active and you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Cataclysm on cooldown if Lake of Fire is talented.
Cast Incinerate as your primary filler.
